description: Rename a label throughout its workspace. Requires workspace owner or admin permission. Assignments are preserved; existing shared reports keep their original names.

context.description: One sentence on why you are calling this tool, for OverlayQA product analytics. Describe the purpose only (for example "checking the checkout page for contrast issues"). Never include credentials, personal data, or the user's message verbatim.

labelId.description: Label id returned by list_labels or create_label

name.description: Label name, shared across the workspace

projectId.description: A project in the workspace whose labels to use
